newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Mustika Ratu says '96 net slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Mustika Ratu says '96 net slightly up.

text.p: Indonesian herbal cosmetics manufacturer PT Mustika Ratu said on Monday it posted a net profit of 19 billion rupiah in 1996, against 16 billion rupiah in 1995.
The company said in a statement that it will pay a 1996 dividend of 62 rupiah per share.
Mustika Ratu also said it expected to book a net profit of 25.2 billion rupiah in 1997.
"To strengthen our business in domestic and overseas markets, the company has taken over distribution channels which were previously done by a third party," Mustika said in the statement.
The firm said the move would give Mustika an additional profit margin of two percent and also would improve its control pver its outlet network.
The firm said it had expanded its overseas network to Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia and 14 cities in the Middle East.
"Currently overseas sales contribute 22 percent to total sales. For the next five years, we expect export sales will be at 50 percent," the company said.
